criteria.requirement: Implement marshmallow.streaming.iterload(schema,records,*,errors="raise",partial=None,unknown=None) and Schema.iterload with frozen LoadResult(index,status,data,errors,valid_data). Validate options before consuming data, remain lazy, and call actual schema.load(many=False) per record so hooks/custom loads, partial and unknown policies work even for Schema(many=True). Raise retains original ValidationError; collect continues after invalid rows and reuses completed error_paths.flatten_errors, detaches valid_data and never stores raw input or exception objects. Non-validation exceptions must propagate; no global schema options or hook bypasses.
Deliver the authorized source changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. All frozen native regression tests must pass.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual program behavior; do not grade by matching reference text or its length.
